heyo! highlighting a few extra docs:

[*Relays in a post-ePBS world*](https://ethresear.ch/t/relays-in-a-post-epbs-world/16278) – highlights the "bypassability" ideas.
[*Proposer-initiated splitting*](https://ethresear.ch/t/payload-timeliness-committee-ptc-an-epbs-design/16054#proposer-initiated-splitting-18)  – discusses (in my view) the biggest issue with ePBS constructions.
[*Consider the ePBS*](https://notes.ethereum.org/@mikeneuder/consider-the-epbs) – outlines why i don't think the Feb 6 incident should change the perspective on ePBS.

I am also hoping to write a short doc on "ePBS with builder collateral" to share my perspective on that version of the design! for extra links on ePBS, see: https://notes.ethereum.org/@mikeneuder/infinite-buffet. 

hope this helps!

my goal for this call is to get everyone on the same page around the state of ePBS r&d and hopefully reach consensus on plausibility for pectra (which kind of started this whole arc).

I think having a call around state of R&D is _super_ valuable and my personal opinion is that ePBS is not ready for pectra (although happy to be convinced otherwise :) ). that being said, calls like this are a great way to accelerate the R&D so that we can compress shipping timelines on ePBS generally

here's my suggested agenda:

* stokes gives overview of mev-boost today and why we want to enshrine PBS
  * auction for builders to buy blockspace from proposers
  * need trusted intermediary: relay
    * brokers exchange to ensure:
    * payload validity
    * and auction payment
  * relays are single points of failure, targets for implementation of censorship, also big funding question
  * remove the relay by enshrining its functions into the protocol
    * builders and proposers can use gossip infra to coordinate
    * use protocol to enforce payment
  * still, questions…
    * is the payload valid and on time? => PTC
    * “splitting” attacks to grief builder
    * gossip better than point-to-point comms?
    * do builders pay JIT or is collateral locked?
* potuz, terence, (and others?) have been working on an ePBS flavor
  * state of research & implementation
  * key resource: https://ethresear.ch/t/minimal-epbs-beacon-chain-changes/18653
* open questions / discussion

Thanks @ralexstokes!

My general thoughts were:

* highlight designs (and as you note, the current "design" is extra-protocol)
* in doing so — highlight unknowns, tough design decisions, non-optimalities that exists. As well as to ground everyone in rough engineering complexity
* This should help next steps:
    * Are we at the point to transition out of R&D and into concrete specs and semi-production development [regardless of the target fork]
    * and if not, what is the path to get there, who needs to be involved, etc

Main thing I would add is that we might want to try to make it explicit as to the problem(s) that are attempting to be solved. I find that in ePBS conversations, that all parties often don't agree or have entire overlap on this. I suppose your exposition on mev-boost will anchor this, but I really want to hear from a diverse set here.
